name: FPSO/FSO hook-up, offloading and commissioning
description: Bring a tanker-based FPSO/FSO to site, moor it, connect risers/flowlines/umbilicals and offloading system, hook up pre-laid moorings (often with AHTS + ROV), then commission and hand over.

specifications.basis: Wikipedia Oil platform, Floating production systems
specifications.value: FPSO = large monohull, usually ship-shaped, with processing facilities, moored for extended periods and not drilling; FSO/FSU used exclusively for storage with little process equipment
